name: High Inquisitor Whitemane
summary: Whitemane is the High Inquisitor of the Scarlet Crusade, presiding over the Cathedral of the Scarlet Monastery. A powerful priestess of the Holy Light, her consuming hatred for the undead drives the Crusade's uncompromising zealotry. Together with Scarlet Commander Renault Mograine, she directs the order's military and ideological campaigns across Lordaeron.

sections.title: High Inquisitor of the Crusade
sections.body: Rising rapidly through the Scarlet Crusade's hierarchy, Whitemane became its High Inquisitor and took command of the Scarlet Monastery's grand Cathedral. Renowned for her fearsome mastery of Holy magic, she has become one of the Crusade's foremost symbols through her absolute conviction, wielding the Light as an unrelenting weapon against any deemed unclean.

sections.title: Targets in the Cathedral
sections.body: By 25 ADP, Whitemane's fanaticism has drawn enemies from both factions. In Southshore, Raleigh the Devout believes the Crusade has strayed irreparably into corruption and madness, calling for the elimination of Whitemane and Mograine to restore the order's founding virtues. Meanwhile, within the Undercity, the dreadlord Varimathras orchestrates strikes against the Monastery to crush the zealots operating directly on the Forsaken's doorstep.

faq.answer: Whitemane is the High Inquisitor of the Scarlet Crusade. She commands the order's spiritual and inquisitorial efforts from the Cathedral inside the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades, fighting alongside Commander Renault Mograine.

faq.q: Why does Whitemane hate the undead so much?
faq.answer: Her hatred mirrors the Scarlet Crusade's own creed. The order rose from the survivors of Lordaeron's fall to the plague of undeath, and it treats every undead, mindless or free-willed, as an abomination to be purged. Whitemane wields the Holy Light as its most relentless weapon in that war.

faq.q: Why does the Alliance want Whitemane dead?
aliases: in the name of the light quest
faq.answer: Raleigh the Devout, a former Crusader in Southshore, believes the Scarlet Crusade has devolved into paranoia and madness. He asks Alliance champions to eliminate Whitemane and Mograine so the order can potentially return to its honorable origins.

faq.q: Why does the Horde want Whitemane dead?
faq.answer: Varimathras and the Forsaken in the Undercity view the Scarlet Crusade as an active, hostile presence right outside their capital. The dreadlord orders her death to shatter the Monastery's leadership and remove an immediate threat to the Forsaken realm.

faq.q: What is Whitemane's relationship with Renault Mograine?
faq.answer: Whitemane and Renault Mograine are the dual leaders of the Scarlet Monastery. Fighting side by side in the Cathedral, they share an intimate bond and mutual devotion to the Crusade's crusade against undeath.

angles.text: Whitemane demonstrates the terrifying power of the Holy Light when fused with unbending zealotry, serving as a cautionary example of how conviction can transform into fanatical ruthlessness.
To paladins of the Silver Hand, Whitemane's leadership exemplifies the tragic corruption of Lordaeron's defenders, who abandoned mercy and justice in favor of indiscriminate purges.
To the Forsaken, Whitemane embodies the Crusade's refusal to distinguish between mindless Scourge and free-willed undead, making her destruction essential for the survival of the Undercity.

Though she was once an Alliance citizen of Lordaeron, Whitemane's Crusade now attacks any outsiders who approach their lands, forcing Southshore's loyalists to confront the monsters their former kin have become.
